observation_fields.meaning: 5 by 5 local patch, dy then dx from -2 through +2, then channel; outside world all -1. Channels: 0=terrain value / 10; 1=actor identity (id + 1) / A; 2=role (role + 1) / R; 3=home crew (team + 1) / C; 4=held tool / 4; 5=cargo type / 4; 6=cargo amount / 4; 7=stamina / 20; 8=carried message / 4; 9=pump identity (index + 1) / capacity; 10=intake sand burden / 4; 11=intake actively held clear / 1; 12=shared row aquifer water / 32; 13=wind side 0 west or 1 east / 1; 14=cistern identity (index + 1) / capacity; 15=cistern water / 12; 16=stock identity (index + 1) / capacity; 17=remaining building blocks / 24; 18=gate identity (index + 1) / capacity; 19=gate staffed this tick / 1; 20=outgoing carried message / 4; 21=received upstream message / 4; 22=camel identity (index + 1) / capacity; 23=camel hydration / 8; 24=water deliveries / 96; 25=well identity (index + 1) / capacity; 26=water remaining for row / 32

task.objective: Deliver 96 water units to moving caravan camels, using maintained wind pumps, physical pipes and shared row aquifers before H=1024.
task.natural_termination: Natural completion at 96 cumulative caravan deliveries; otherwise truncate at 1024.
task.interaction: Pump operation needs another actor holding its intake clear at the same step. Pumps compete for shared row water in geographical upstream order. Wind buries exposed pipes; building walls changes travel, shade and beacon transmission. Staffed gates and water rescue change others opportunities.
task.observation_access: Only own prefix and radius-two Chebyshev 5x5 patch with exact listed channels enter the policy. Visible actor identity, role, crew, tools, cargo, stamina and message are in the patch. Each object attribute is in its group channels. Hidden cells and entities remain hidden; global debugger must be labeled. Clock alone is public.
